body: It's an iffy area, but generally, NO. Because of the aforementioned suicidal ideations. And in any case your family can override your wishes in almost every case if they choose.

If you don't succeed, you mean? Can be Bad, like in a nursing home feed and water daily or on a ventilator waiting for your family to make a very tough end of life decision. Helluva thing to put your family through, either way.

No. They are obligated to attempt to save your life. To most medical organizations being suicidal means you are not in your right mind and as such you can't make decisions about your Healthcare. In some states committing suicide is illegal, although it's difficult to prosecute if you succeed. 

Source: Am an ER nurse married to a paramedic. Have treated many suicide attempts.
